data.title: Luggage chaos, flight delays at Suvarnabhumi airport
data.description: Passengers arriving at Suvarnabhumi airport have been forced to wait five or six hours for their baggage and numerous flights have been delayed since Saturday because off problems with Thai Airways’ ground operations.

data.title: Nida Poll: Opposition leader and his party most popular
data.description: An opinion survey found most respondents liked the opposition-core People's Party (PP) and its leader over Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and his Bhumjaithai Party (BJT).

data.title: ONE Championship: Asadula Imangazaliev to defend title in Ortikov grand prix rematch
data.description: Asadula Imangazaliev will put his ONE Championship flyweight Muay Thai world title on the line against Aslamjon Ortikov on November 20, with their immediate rematch also serving as a quarter-final of the promotion’s new grand prix.

data.title: Thousands stranded, Lat Krabang evacuates flooded residents
data.description: Rescuers rushed to evacuate bedridden patients, elderly residents and other vulnerable people from a flood-stricken housing estate in Bangkok's Lat Krabang district on Sunday, with floodwaters neck-high in some places.

data.title: UK Labour party meets buoyed by Burnham but eager for concrete plans
data.description: LIVERPOOL - Britain's ruling Labour Party gathers Sunday for its first annual conference under Andy Burnham's leadership, heartened by his start as prime minister but now looking for concrete plans to tackle looming challenges.

data.title: Swiss vote on what it means to be neutral
data.description: GENEVA - The Swiss are voting Sunday on a much-debated proposal to tighten their country's cherished neutrality, with polls indicating most will reject the initiative championed by the hard-right and dubbed "pro-Russian" by opponents.

data.title: AGT winner Nene Royal arrives back in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - America's Got Talent 2026 winner Nene Royal arrived back home on this southern tourist island on Sunday morning to a warm welcome and a planned evening parade.

data.title: Krungthai and EXIM Bank expand aid for flood-hit borrowers
data.description: Krungthai and EXIM Bank are offering debt relief, lower interest rates and added liquidity to customers and businesses in Thailand affected by floods

data.title: Thousands protest ahead of Mexican president's report on missing students
data.description: MEXICO CITY - Thousands of protesters wore red and carried symbolic coffins during a demonstration in Mexico City on Saturday, demanding answers about the 43 trainee teachers who went missing 12 years ago.

data.title: Bangkok floods force thousands into shelters
data.description: BANGKOK - Thousands of Bangkok residents awoke in shelters on Sunday after flooding triggered by days of heavy rain in the Thai capital inundated homes and roads, with some starting to dry out their homes and belongings.

data.title: Schoolboy hailed for clearing rubbish from flooded city street
data.description: Amid heavy flooding in Bangkok, a schoolboy's simple act of civic-mindedness has drawn widespread praise online after he was filmed wading through murky water to collect floating rubbish before it could clog the drains.

data.title: Curtain falls on the romance of India's single-screen cinemas
data.description: BENGALURU, India - The demolition has begun at Bengaluru's Urvashi Cinema, once a 1,200-seat movie palace where generations of filmgoers cheered and whistled, another casualty of India's vanishing single-screen era.

data.title: Thailand’s GSB and GHB offer debt relief and loans for flood victims
data.description: Eligible borrowers in Thailand can access payment holidays, interest relief and recovery loans, with separate packages for households and businesses.

data.title: Japanese anime actor fights TikTok over AI voice cloning
data.description: TOKYO - A high-profile Japanese anime voice actor has taken TikTok to court over videos he says feature an artificial intelligence clone of his "lustrous" baritone, with a verdict due on Wednesday.

data.title: Heavy flooding continues in eastern Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt said heavy flooding continued in eastern districts of Bangkok, where most main canals remained full on Sunday.

data.title: More rain in Central Plains, will ease off in Bangkok
data.description: It will rain heavily in the western part of the Central Plains while rain will continue and then start to decline in Greater Bangkok and the East on Sunday, according to the Meteorological Department.

data.title: Venezuela releases more political prisoners after opposition talks
data.description: CARACAS - More than three dozen political prisoners were released between Friday and Saturday, a rights group reported, after US-backed talks between Venezuela's interim government and the opposition.

data.title: Seaplane project studied
data.description: SATUN: Transport Ministry is assessing the feasibility of seaplane operations on Koh Lipe, focusing on safety and environmental impacts.

data.title: Filmmaker Mike Leigh wins top prize at Spain festival with 'last film'
data.description: SAN SEBASTIAN (SPAIN) - British filmmaker Mike Leigh won the top prize Saturday at the San Sebastian film festival for his latest social drama "Tender Loving Care", expected to be the last by the 83-year-old who is suffering from an illness.

data.title: Unlicensed hotels closed
data.description: PHUKET: Five hotels in the province have been ordered to suspend operations temporarily after authorities found that they failed to obtain licences and meet improvement requirements.

data.title: Govt defends solar sector as China supplies 99.3% of imports
data.description: The government has defended the domestic solar industry after figures showed China supplied 99.3% of solar-panel imports in the first seven months of 2026.

data.title: CP firm to run Airport Rail Link until January under same rules
data.description: The State Railway of Thailand and Asia Era One, a CP Group company, have agreed that the private firm will keep running the Airport Rail Link for four more months.

data.title: Klatham keeps options open
data.description: The Klatham Party has caused a stir by going against the opposition whip's position and voting in support of the 2027 budget bill.

data.title: 10,000 troops sent to flood-hit provinces
data.description: More than 10,000 troops and 1,000 vehicles have been deployed nationwide to help people hit by heavy rain and flooding.

data.title: City storms likely to ease this week
data.description: Rainfall in Bangkok and parts of central and eastern Thailand is expected to ease from Monday, although flood-prone areas remain under watch.

data.title: Big turn out for Central bid to aid women with cancer
data.description: The heart of Bangkok came alive with colour, smiles and a spirit of giving as runners from across Thailand gathered at the outdoor square at CentralWorld for the 18th Central Group Mini Marathon by Good Goods. The event brought participants together to exercise, connect with fellow runners and support women with cancer.
